Policy fixture: remote page

Served from loopback, which foob treats as remote (untrusted). Click each item and compare with the expected result. The window title (see niri msg windows) must read Policy fixture (remote) — foob: the hidden direction override and the extra spaces in this page's title are removed.

  1. New-window link to a remote page
    Expected: opens in this window ("Second page").
  2. Ordinary link to a remote page (control)
    Expected: opens in this window.
  3. New-window link to a local file
    Expected: nothing happens (remote content never opens local content).
  4. Ordinary link to a local file
    Expected: nothing happens (WebKit refuses it).

  5. Expected: nothing happens; the log below says returned null (window.open is unsupported until M2-11 / M3-01).

  6. Expected: nothing happens; the log below says returned null.
  7. Link to an attachment download
    Expected: nothing happens; no file in your Downloads folder. The server terminal shows GET /attachment.bin (the request still reaches the server).
  8. Link with the download attribute
    Expected: nothing happens; no file is saved.

Record only (features arrive in M3; note what happens today)

  1. Choose a file.
    Record: does a picker open, nothing, or something else? (M3-02)

  2. Record: any prompt? The log should say a permission error. (M3-05)
  3. Link to a PDF
    Record: what is shown? (M3-04)
  4. Right-click anywhere on the page.
    Record: is a context menu shown? (M3-01)
